review.gallery: Six distinct developer renders from the branded Wares factsheet and physical pages 9, 11 and 12 of the multi-project brochure. Other projects’ panels and lifestyle stock were excluded.
review.location: Factsheet page 2 marks Wares off E11. Eight times on physical page 1 were checked visually. The project-name directions query is used because the map is schematic.
review.floorPlans: All 20 DJAZ2.28 residential sheets and the second-floor plate were visually reviewed. Brochure pages 13–14 corroborate the same first two studios and representative one- and two-bedroom plans. Printed totals and Type 03A title conflict are retained.

unavailable: The factsheet mentions three-bedroom homes, but the reviewed plan pack does not provide a verified three-bedroom or retail plan. Entrance coordinates and route measurements were not established.
